video_title: Chiney's WNBA Picks, Nneka's Next Chapter & NBA vs. WNBA Coverage

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Nneka Ogwumike's retirement from the WNBA
quotes.excerpt: She just announced today, this is her final season, she is retiring from the WNBA.

text_blocks.speaker: Breanna Stewart
text_blocks.text: Speaking of Nneka, we have to give a shout out to Nneka. She just announced today, this is her final season, she is retiring from the WNBA.

text_blocks.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
text_blocks.text: I am so proud of her. You never want to see your favorites or the people that you compete against hang them up. It is always awkward because maybe it makes you feel like, am I that much closer? When I was leaving college, you were coming in. You were my final game.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: The Las Vegas Aces' pursuit of four championships in five years
quotes.excerpt: The fact that the Aces could win four championships in five years, their success has been normalized.
quotes.quote: There are some mainstream storylines that we haven't been talking about. The fact that the Aces could win four championships in five years, their success has been normalized. Similar with Asia's. Do you remember when you were a rookie, getting to 80 points was like, wow, y'all were balling. Now it is so normal. The greatness that we are seeing, the scoring that we are seeing is awesome, and we haven't really talked about it, but that is mainstream.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: The Washington Mystics' success as a young team
quotes.excerpt: The Washington Mystics' success this year has been really cool. They are cooking on a slow boil.
quotes.quote: The Washington Mystics' success this year has been really cool. They are in the playoff mix and being the youngest team in the WNBA. Shakira Austin, how well she has been playing especially post-All-Star. I think the Mystics are, Nneka actually said this on draft night, they are cooking on a slow boil. It is now starting to boil over.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Sonia Citron's efficiency and underrated play
quotes.excerpt: Sonia Citron will shoot the ball 15 times and have 28 to 30. Her efficiency is nuts.
quotes.quote: Sonia Citron. She will shoot the ball 15 times and have 28 to 30. Her efficiency is nuts. She is a shot maker and just does it so calmly. So that is another underrated player.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Philadelphia 76ers' championship pressure with LeBron James and Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: I feel like the obvious answer is Philly because LeBron is coming to win a championship.
quotes.quote: I feel like the obvious answer is Philly because LeBron is coming to win a championship. He gave himself a little bit of a window for two years. You get Jaylen Brown. Last year we were talking about the 53 years it took for the Knicks to get back to the mountain top to win a championship. They are dealing with another championship drought. You get what people argue to be of our generation the greatest. You add someone that was top six in MVP voting. You have the most explosive backcourt in Tyrese and Jaylen Brown. They have less of a usage potentially now on Joel Embiid.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: The Victor Wembanyama era in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: During Wembanyama's run, we have officially entered the Victor Wembanyama era of the NBA.
quotes.quote: During Wembanyama's run, we have officially entered the Victor Wembanyama era of the NBA. People are going to say that in his third year in the league, he took his team to the NBA Finals. He took down the defending champs, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the reigning MVP in Shai and the Oklahoma City Thunder. This was the moment that people are like, okay, he has arrived and he is coming for it. So I think it is already started. The question is how soon will he actually achieve it.
